HomePage.faqTitle: Questions about downloading, extracting, and converting media.
faqs: How do I download an online video?
Paste the public video or playlist link and click download. Baixaboo detects the link type, prepares the file, and releases it through your browser.
What is the maximum video quality?
Baixaboo looks for the best available option up to Full HD 1080p with audio. The final resolution also depends on the quality provided by the source.
Do I need to install software or create an account?
No. The tools work directly in a modern browser and require no installation or registration.
Which audio and video formats are supported?
You can work with MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, AAC, and OGG for audio, plus MP4, WebM, MOV, and MKV for video.
We do not keep a library of your files. They are used temporarily to complete the task and are automatically removed by the service.
Only use your own content, public-domain material, content licensed for download, or content authorized by its owner. You are responsible for respecting copyright and source terms.

0.question: Can I download any content?
0.answer: No. You should process only your own content or content for which you have authorization, a license, or another valid legal basis.

1.question: Is Baixaboo affiliated with other platforms?
1.answer: No. Baixaboo is independent and is not affiliated with, partnered with, sponsored by, or endorsed by supported platforms.

2.question: Is YouTube the focus of Baixaboo?
2.answer: No. YouTube may be a supported source, but Baixaboo processes different types of links and authorized media files.

3.question: Which formats are available?
3.answer: The available options depend on the original media and the processing service's capabilities.

4.question: Can I download audio only?
4.answer: Yes, when the source provides a compatible audio track.

5.question: Are files stored?
5.answer: No. Content is streamed during the download and is not saved by Baixaboo.

6.question: Can I use the file commercially?
6.answer: Only when the license or authorization from the rights holder permits commercial use.

7.question: Does Baixaboo remove content protection?
7.answer: No. Baixaboo does not bypass DRM, paywalls, access restrictions, or protection mechanisms.

8.question: Will downloads always be available?
8.answer: No. Availability depends on the source, content, permissions, format, and technical or legal limitations.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.intro: This Policy explains which data Baixaboo processes, for what purposes, and for how long, in accordance with applicable Brazilian data-protection law.

items.0: Media links voluntarily submitted by the user for validation and download;
items.1: Files uploaded for extraction or conversion and files prepared for delivery, processed temporarily while the task is running;
items.2: Technical access and security data, such as IP address, date and time, device type, browser, language, and error logs;
items.3: A random session identifier, protected by a signature and stored in an HttpOnly cookie, used to associate a task with the browser and enforce usage limits;
items.4: Preferences saved locally on the device, such as theme and language;
items.5: Usage data, identifiers, and events collected by measurement and advertising services when applicable and according to the user's privacy choices.

items.0: Receive the request, prepare the media, and deliver the file to the browser;
items.1: Keep a task session available after a page refresh;
items.2: Maintain security, prevent abuse, investigate failures, and limit automated usage;
items.3: Measure performance and improve the platform experience;
items.4: Display, measure, and limit ad repetition when Google AdSense is active.

retention.title: 3. Files and retention
retention.text: Baixaboo does not maintain a permanent media library or media database. To prepare downloads, playlists, extractions, and conversions, media may be written to isolated temporary directories. Ready files normally expire within 15 minutes if not downloaded and are removed a few minutes after delivery; active transfers and long-running tasks have technical limits of up to 6 and 12 hours. Remaining directories are also cleaned automatically after failures or service restarts.

sharing.title: 4. Sharing
sharing.text: We do not sell personal data. Technical data may be processed by hosting, network, and security providers required to operate the service, by Microsoft Clarity for usage measurement, and by Google and advertising partners when AdSense is active. We may also disclose data when required by law or a competent authority.

cookies.title: 5. Cookies, local storage, and advertising
cookies.text: Baixaboo uses essential technologies and, when enabled, optional measurement and advertising technologies:

items.0: baixaboo_session: an essential, signed, HttpOnly cookie with a maximum lifetime of 30 days; it contains no name, email address, or login;
items.1: Local storage: stores preferences such as theme and minimal information required to resume an active task;
items.2: Microsoft Clarity: may measure interactions, performance, and sessions through analytics cookies and identifiers;
items.3: Google AdSense and partners: may use cookies, web beacons, IP addresses, and other identifiers to serve, personalize, and measure ads based on this visit and earlier visits.

AboutPage.title: Media tools with a direct experience
AboutPage.intro: Baixaboo is an independent project created to bring common media tasks together in a simple, accessible, and transparent interface.

purpose.title: Our purpose
purpose.text: We want to remove unnecessary steps for people working with their own media: preparing an authorized file from a link, extracting an audio track, removing audio from a video, or converting a file to a compatible format.

operation.title: How the service works
operation.text: The browser sends only the data required for the selected task. The backend validates the request, processes it in temporary storage, and delivers the result to the user. We do not create a public library, index submitted links, or require user accounts.

items.0: Clearly explain what is processed and for how long;
items.1: Collect only data needed for operation, security, measurement, and disclosed advertising;
items.2: Maintain accessible navigation on mobile and desktop devices;
items.3: Respond to privacy, support, and copyright requests through a public contact channel.

independence.title: Independence and responsible use
independence.text: Baixaboo is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by YouTube, Google, or other mentioned platforms. Users must process only their own, public-domain, licensed, or expressly authorized content and comply with applicable law and source terms.

funding.title: How the project is funded
funding.text: Operations may be funded by clearly identified advertising. Ads do not alter tool results, are never presented as download buttons, and do not waive privacy or responsible-use requirements.
